name: easyslides
description: Create editable research presentations directly, or approve AI-generated slide images and rebuild whole slides or selected regions. Includes native templates, image references, and PPTX distillation.

interface.shortDescription: Editable slides, AI image reconstruction, and template reuse.
interface.longDescription: Choose direct editable PPT creation, AI-generated images followed by full-slide reconstruction, or reconstruction of annotated regions. EasySlides asks for your choice and explains relative time and token costs. Image routes use Codex imagegen when available, then offer full-vector rebuilding or preserved complex pictures with native text. Browse seven native templates and thirteen image-reference styles, or distill your own PPTX into reusable assets. Delivery includes previews, editable scope, and known limitations.
defaultPrompt: 使用 EasySlides 把这个 PPTX 蒸馏为无内容的语义模板、组件和符号资产。
Use EasySlides to create a research presentation. Ask me to choose a production method and show relative time and token costs.
Use EasySlides to rebuild the annotated regions of these approved slide images. Ask which reconstruction mode I prefer.
